description:
Fantom Corporation is a mission-focused organization supporting critical programs across the defense and intelligence community. We partner with our customers to deliver high-impact technical solutions while fostering a culture built on trust, expertise, and long-term career growth. 
 
We are seeking an experienced Cybersecurity Penetration Tester to assess the security of complex enterprise systems, networks, and virtualized environments. This role will conduct hands-on adversarial testing, identify vulnerabilities, analyze security risks, and develop mitigation recommendations to strengthen the overall security posture.
 

Responsibilities

 Provide operations and maintenance support for existing ServiceNow applications and instances

 Design and develop new ServiceNow applications based on customer requirements

 Create and maintain Business Rules, UI Policies, Client Scripts, and Access Control Lists (ACLs)

 Develop and modify ServiceNow workflows, catalog items, and record producers

 Develop and maintain ServiceNow portals

 Create automated notifications, reports, and daily reporting capabilities

 Manage and optimize workflow processes within ServiceNow

 Develop and integrate web application APIs

 Support Microsoft SQL Server databases and related application integrations

 Participate in Agile development activities and track requirements and issues using JIRA

 Support application lifecycle activities, including development, testing, deployment, maintenance, and documentation

 Incorporate information security requirements and policies into technical solutions and documentation


Required Qualifications

 Demonstrated ServiceNow development, administration, and workflow management experience

 Experience developing ServiceNow Business Rules, UI Policies, Client Scripts, and ACLs

 Experience with ServiceNow workflows, catalog items, record producers, portals, notifications, and reporting

 Strong JavaScript development experience

 Experience developing within an Agile environment and using JIRA

 Experience supporting and administering Microsoft SQL Server

 Familiarity with MySQL and PHP scripting

 Familiarity with Windows Server installation and configuration

 Familiarity with web application APIs

 Familiarity with incorporating information security policies into technical requirements


Desired Qualifications

 Experience with relational databases such as Oracle, MySQL, or SQL Server

 Experience with object-oriented programming

 Familiarity with Linux and Windows operating environments

 Experience supporting the software development lifecycle, including formal reviews and milestones

 Experience supporting secure government or Intelligence Community technical environments

 Experience delivering technical briefings to management and stakeholders

 Strong communication skills with the ability to work with both technical and non-technical audiences

 Strong customer engagement, collaboration, and team-building skills

 Experience supporting enterprise learning technologies or training environments

 #CJ


Fantom Corp is a Software Development, Agile Cloud, Software Development, Cyber Security (Risk Management, Assessments & Authorization (A&A)), Data, AI Platform (Computer Vision Models), Podcasting Media Services, and IT Services provider. Established in 2015, Fantom Corp serves Federal customers with top-notch Cybersecurity Architects, Data Scientists/Analysts, Software Engineers/Developers, DevSecOps Engineers, Project Managers, Identity, Credential Access Management (ICAM) services , and Cloud-certified practitioners. We excel in delivering emerging technologies such as Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Machine Learning (ML) with a focus on identifying trends, object detection, and classification of structured and unstructured data. Fantom Corp possesses mastery in all aspects of digital audio production. We lead in the ideation and creation of efforts for clients who want to harness the power of podcasting. We guide them in selecting the right show format for their needs and goals. As a Small Business, we possess the innovation, speed and flexibility to meet your requirements.
